reviews.author: Paul Cater | Trefoil Holdings, LLC; Capital Inspectors LLC
reviews.text: The one thing that I will never forget is on the day we where to close the deal I woke up all stressed and worried about how the day would go. When I drove into my parking lot at the office Gary Cooper himself was standing their waiting on me to help walk me through this life changing event.

reviews.author: Bruce Whitaker | President of The Whitaker Companies
reviews.text: As a small firm without in-house tax expertise, finding a reliable and responsive accounting partner was crucial for us, and Cooper CPA Group has exceeded our expectations. What sets this firm apart is their commitment to small businesses and their responsiveness... Moreover, the pricing is reasonable and transparent... If you have an urgent question or challenge, you can pick up the phone and talk to Gary Cooper or any of his senior staff members immediately. I can’t get that level of response from a big accounting firm.

reviews.author: Frederick Warren | Frederick Warren Photography
reviews.text: His team was very thorough in preparing my taxes and always brings the attention to detail that I have no idea of or the time to investigate all the complicated tax codes.

about.title: Over two decades of Houston accounting, built on conversation
text: Cooper CPA Group has served the accounting and tax needs of Houston and the surrounding areas for over two decades.

Gary Cooper has been recognized by ABC News Channel 13 as "Your Rock Star CPA." The firm works with real estate investors, medical professionals, startups, construction firms and retail businesses, among others.
The team runs on a flat organizational chart, which comes from trust in its staff, and a friendly, energetic office. They believe relationships are built only through strong communication.
